shelters.name: Arizona Humane Society
shelters.description: Arizona's largest animal welfare organization, operating the state's largest trauma hospital for homeless animals. Dedicated to saving vulnerable pets through innovative medical programs, emergency rescue, and comprehensive adoption services.

shelters.name: Arizona Animal Welfare League & SPCA
shelters.description: The oldest and largest no-kill shelter in Arizona, founded in 1971. Merged with Arizona SPCA in 2007. Rescues, rehabilitates, and rehomes more than 4,000 dogs and cats annually.

shelters.name: Maricopa County Animal Care and Control - West
shelters.description: One of the nation's largest open-admission shelters, serving the animals and people of Maricopa County with adoption services, vaccinations, spay/neuter, and licensing.

shelters.name: Maricopa County Animal Care and Control - East
shelters.description: East Valley location of Maricopa County Animal Care and Control, providing animal welfare services to Mesa and East Valley communities.

shelters.name: Pima Animal Care Center
shelters.description: The community's only open-admission shelter with the largest selection of adoptable dogs, cats, puppies, and kittens. All adopted pets are microchipped, spayed/neutered, and vaccinated.

shelters.name: Friends of Pima Animal Care Center
shelters.description: Nonprofit partner to Pima Animal Care Center, providing resources to support neglected, abandoned, and abused pets. Named Best Non-Profit in Arizona Daily Star Readers' Choice Awards six consecutive years.

shelters.name: Humane Society of Southern Arizona
shelters.description: Independent local nonprofit established in 1944, dedicated to sheltering and placement of animals, prevention of cruelty, and education on humane treatment.

shelters.name: HALO Animal Rescue
shelters.description: Founded in 1994, HALO provides a safe haven for thousands of homeless dogs and cats annually. Never euthanizes for space and ensures every pet receives full veterinary support before adoption.

shelters.name: Lost Our Home Pet Rescue
shelters.description: No-kill rescue dedicated to bridging the care gap between people in crisis and pets who have no place to go. Programs preserve the human-animal bond whenever possible.

shelters.name: Foothills Animal Rescue
shelters.description: Non-profit founded in 1995, operating an adoption-guarantee facility where dogs and cats remain in care until finding loving homes. Award-winning Brynne Smith Memorial Campus.

shelters.name: Sun Cities 4 Paws Rescue
shelters.description: No-kill cat-only animal rescue and shelter serving the Sun Cities area with adoption services.

shelters.name: Yavapai Humane Society
shelters.description: Private non-profit providing animal care for stray dogs and cats in Prescott, Prescott Valley, and Yavapai County. Operations funded primarily by donations and fundraisers.

shelters.name: United Animal Friends
shelters.description: Volunteer-based 501(c)(3) nonprofit founded in 2003, providing rescue programs including spay/neuter certificates, courtesy listings, and emergency medical assistance.

shelters.name: Verde Valley Humane Society
shelters.description: Provides shelter and care for homeless animals throughout Cottonwood, Verde Valley, Yavapai County, and the Yavapai-Nation.

shelters.name: Humane Society of Central Arizona
shelters.description: Animal shelter providing adoption services for dogs and cats in the Payson and central Arizona area.

shelters.name: HARTT - Humane Animal Rescue & Trapping Team
shelters.description: Volunteer-based nonprofit humanely capturing lost family pets, homeless dogs, and cats who are severely injured throughout the Phoenix area.

shelters.name: AZ Friends for Life Animal Rescue
shelters.description: Advocating for homeless animals in Arizona since 1993, committed to placing the right animal in the right home.

shelters.name: Follow Your Heart Animal Rescue
shelters.description: 501(c)(3) all foster-based rescue in Mesa, Arizona dedicated to saving homeless animals.

shelters.name: Love Connection Dog Rescue
shelters.description: Accepts dogs of all conditions, pulling from county shelters, Indian reservations, and taking dogs requiring board and training. Volunteer foster families care for dogs until adoption.

shelters.name: Pima Paws for Life
shelters.description: Nonprofit believing every animal's life has value, dedicated to rescue and rehoming in the Tucson area.

shelters.name: Underdog Rescue of Arizona
shelters.description: Focuses on saving at-risk shelter dogs one paw at a time throughout the Phoenix metropolitan area.

shelters.name: Yavapai Humane Trappers Animal Search & Rescue
shelters.description: Nonprofit animal rescue, adoption, and foster organization in Northern Arizona. Awarded Gold Seal of Transparency through GuideStar 2023-2024.

shelters.name: Halfway Home Arizona Animal Rescue
shelters.description: Independent cat and dog rescue and foster program serving the Arizona community.

shelters.name: Arizona Humane Society - Papago Park Campus
shelters.description: Second campus of Arizona Humane Society providing adoption services, veterinary care, and community programs in the Papago Park area.

shelters.name: Coconino Humane Association
shelters.description: Serving the Flagstaff and Coconino County area with animal shelter and adoption services.

notes: Comprehensive collection of Arizona animal shelters, humane societies, SPCAs, and rescue organizations. Major organizations include Arizona Humane Society (largest in state), AAWL & SPCA (oldest/largest no-kill), and Maricopa County ACC (one of nation's largest open-admission shelters). Coverage spans Phoenix metro, Tucson, Prescott, Flagstaff, and surrounding areas.
